summary.ja: 「{特定|とくてい}{技能|ぎのう}」「{技能|ぎのう}{実習|じっしゅう}」は、{決|き}まった{受入|うけい}れ{先|さき}での{仕事|しごと}・{実習|じっしゅう}のための{在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}です。ふつうのアルバイトと{同|おな}じには{考|かんが}えません。{始|はじ}める{前|まえ}に、{下|した}の{案内|あんない}と{相談|そうだん}{先|さき}で{確|たし}かめてください（{要|よう}{確認|かくにん}）。

summary.en: These statuses are for work or training at a set host organisation. Do not treat a side job like an ordinary part-time job; check before you start (to be checked).

text.en: With Specified Skilled Worker status you cannot do part-time work at another company (ISA Q&A).

text.en: Technical intern activities follow the training plan. Before any other work, ask your host, supervising organisation or OTIT (to be checked).

text.en: From 1 April 2027, the new Employment for Skill Development system replaces technical intern training (future rule).
